question.stem: Which of the following statements are correct? Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

statements.label: A
statements.text: An excessive loss of body fluid from the body switches off osmoreceptors.

statements.label: B
statements.text: ADH facilitates water reabsorption to prevent diuresis.

statements.label: C
statements.text: ANF causes vasodilation.

statements.label: D
statements.text: ADH causes increase in blood pressure.

statements.label: E
statements.text: ADH is responsible for decrease in GFR.

steps: A: excessive loss of body fluid activates osmoreceptors, which trigger ADH release, so A is false.
B: ADH facilitates water reabsorption in the distal tubule and collecting duct, preventing diuresis, so B is true.
C: ANF causes vasodilation and lowers blood pressure, so C is true.
D: ADH constricts blood vessels, raising blood pressure, so D is true.
E: by raising blood pressure, ADH can increase glomerular blood flow and GFR, not decrease it, so E is false.
True set $= \{B, C, D\}$, which is option $4$.
ai_solution.html:
1. A: excessive loss of body fluid activates osmoreceptors, which trigger ADH release, so A is false.
  2. B: ADH facilitates water reabsorption in the distal tubule and collecting duct, preventing diuresis, so B is true.
  3. C: ANF causes vasodilation and lowers blood pressure, so C is true.
  4. D: ADH constricts blood vessels, raising blood pressure, so D is true.
  5. E: by raising blood pressure, ADH can increase glomerular blood flow and GFR, not decrease it, so E is false.
  6. True set = {B, C, D}, which is option 4.
ai_solution.why: A is false (fluid loss activates, not switches off, osmoreceptors); B, C, D are true; E is false (ADH raises BP and so can increase GFR), giving B, C and D only.

question.stem: Which of the following statements are correct regarding skeletal muscle? Choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:

statements.label: A
statements.text: Muscle bundles are held together by collagenous connective tissue layer called fascicle.

statements.label: B
statements.text: Sarcoplasmic reticulum of muscle fibre is a store house of calcium ions.

statements.label: C
statements.text: Striated appearance of skeletal muscle fibre is due to distribution pattern of actin and myosin proteins.

statements.label: D
statements.text: M line is considered as functional unit of contraction called sarcomere.

steps: Statement A: muscle bundles (fascicles) are held together by a collagenous connective tissue layer called fascia, not fascicle, so $A$ is false.
Statement B: the sarcoplasmic reticulum stores $\mathrm{Ca^{2+}}$ ions, so $B$ is true.
Statement C: the striations come from the distribution pattern of actin and myosin, so $C$ is true.
Statement D: the sarcomere is the part of the myofibril between two successive Z lines, not the M line, so $D$ is false.
Correct set is $\{B, C\}$, which is option $4$.
ai_solution.html:
1. Statement A: muscle bundles (fascicles) are held together by a collagenous connective tissue layer called fascia, not fascicle, so A is false.
  2. Statement B: the sarcoplasmic reticulum stores Ca2+ ions, so B is true.
  3. Statement C: the striations come from the distribution pattern of actin and myosin, so C is true.
  4. Statement D: the sarcomere is the part of the myofibril between two successive Z lines, not the M line, so D is false.
  5. Correct set is {B, C}, which is option 4.
ai_solution.why: A is false (the collagenous layer is fascia; the bundles are fascicles), D is false (the sarcomere lies between two Z lines); B and C are true.

Check statement D: the sarcomere is the portion between two successive Z lines, not the M line, so D is an altered line and false (consistent with dropping 1 and 2)

Check statement A word by word: NCERT says muscle bundles (fascicles) are held together by a collagenous layer called fascia, so naming the layer 'fascicle' is the one-word swap that decides between options 3 and 4 (C is common to both)
difficulty.why: Hard: after B removes options 1 and 2 the question comes down to two live options separated only by a single altered word in statement A ('fascicle' for 'fascia'), and statement D is also an altered line (M line for the Z-line boundary of a sarcomere), so the candidate has to check four statements and catch two NCERT-line alterations.
difficulty.what_makes_it_hard: Statement A is NCERT's sentence with one word changed: fascicle (the bundle) and fascia (the connective tissue layer) appear side by side in the same NCERT line, so a candidate who recognises the sentence without reading the keyword picks option 3.
